design_inference: All tenant footprints, stock counts, circulation dimensions and staff work arrangements are game-authored. Public source photos do not establish a measured Homeplus plan.
runtime_policy: Small decorative props are static, use shared materials/meshes and existing spatial batching. No individual item networking, new gameplay interaction, or HUD change. Furniture has coarse collision; fine decorative parts do not.
